verdict.rationale: Okta documents event hooks: outbound HTTPS REST calls to a URL you specify when specified events occur in your org. That is a first-party way to export identity events programmatically. The official MCP server's example of listing "all failed login attempts from the last 24 hours" also implies authentication events can be queried through Okta's Admin APIs. Neither confirms a complete, structured, queryable system log or native SIEM streaming. Missing for 10: documented System Log API with query/filter semantics, coverage of every identity event, native log streaming to SIEMs (e.g., Splunk/EventBridge), export formats/retention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
